activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A stock in an uptrend breaks its steep first trendline, rallies, breaks a flatter second fan line, and today closes 4% below the third fan line for the second consecutive day. What does this confirm?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A stock in an uptrend breaks its steep first trendline, rallies, breaks a flatter second fan line, and today closes 4% below the third fan line for the second consecutive day. What does this confirm?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: A confirmed trend reversal: the breaking of the third fan line satisfies the Fan Principle, passes both the 3% price filter and 2-day time filter, and turns the broken third line into overhead resistance.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
